defects: Adds Module.Free R N as a hypothesis, which is not present in gold and is not implied by the other hypotheses (N can be a non-free R-module, e.g. R=ℤ, S=ℚ, N=ℚ), so the produced statement covers a strictly narrower class of cases
Adds Module.Finite S N as a hypothesis, whereas gold's finrank equality holds unconditionally (including the infinite-dimensional case, where finrank is 0 on both sides by Mathlib convention)
Strengthens CommRing S to Field S; gold only assumes CommRing S together with IsFractionRing R S, which does not force R to be a domain or S to be a field
Weakens AddCommGroup N to AddCommMonoid N, not matching gold's stated structure (even if derivable in this ring setting, it's a different stated hypothesis)

Conclusion is phrased as Module.rank R N = (finrank S N : Cardinal) instead of gold's finrank S N = finrank R N; this only coincides with gold's statement once the extra finiteness/freeness hypotheses are assumed, so it is not the same generality of claim
